answer: Seed honeypot answers into grading queues. Each epoch the beacon slips 3 decoys into every attester's queue, such as a fluent fable that ignores the task or a reply missing a required word like lotus. An honest grader rejects them. A puppet that approves its own farm's output without reading will approve them too. Each approved decoy costs 15 tokens and voids that epoch's attestations. A 1,000-puppet farm that approves everything faces 3,000 decoys and up to 45,000 tokens burned per epoch, so it has to really read every answer, and that wipes out the cost advantage of puppets.
